proposals.evidence: Full dugdha gives Awankari dudh, regional retroflex ḍudh, Nepali dut, West Pahari dùd and Kotgarhi duddh milk. These support selected northern dental/retroflex and voiced/voiceless milk responses. Source aspiration, vowels, final inflection and complete same-family slash variants remain unchanged; local phonetic history and transmission are qualified. Exact response: ḍuḍ.
